description: Test suite for the iscc_sdk's IsccMeta class, verifying validation, serialization, and object properties.

methods.name: test_IsccMeta_extra_forbid
methods.description: Tests that invalid extra fields and disallowed modifications raise appropriate errors.

methods.name: test_IsccMeta_validate_assignment
methods.description: Verifies that assigning an invalid value to iscc raises a ValidationError.

methods.name: test_IsccMeta_dict_defaults_exclude_none_unset
methods.description: Checks that the default dictionary representation of IsccMeta contains only the set fields.

methods.name: test_IsccMeta_json
methods.description: Ensures the JSON serialization of IsccMeta matches the expected string.

methods.name: test_IsccMeta_jcs
methods.description: Verifies the JCS (JSON Compact String) output of IsccMeta.

methods.name: test_IsccMeta_iscc_obj
methods.description: Checks that the iscc_obj attribute is an instance of ic.Code.
